description: Source code for the OutputGLSLBase class, part of the ANGLE project, responsible for generating GLSL shader code from intermediate representations. Contains methods for writing qualifiers, variable types, layout qualifiers, and traversing shader AST nodes.

classes.name: TOutputGLSLBase
classes.description: Class responsible for generating GLSL shader code from intermediate shader representation, handling syntax, qualifiers, layout, and AST traversal.

methods.name: writeInvariantQualifier
methods.description: Writes the 'invariant' qualifier if applicable based on shader type and options.

methods.name: writeFloat
methods.description: Outputs a floating-point value, handling special cases like infinity and NaN for GLSL.

methods.name: writeTriplet
methods.description: Outputs code segments based on AST traversal visit type, with optional prefix/suffix strings.

methods.name: writeBuiltInFunctionTriplet
methods.description: Outputs GLSL code for built-in functions, with optional emulation.

methods.name: getCommonLayoutQualifiers
methods.description: Generates layout qualifiers for variables, such as index, yuv, and internal format.

methods.name: getMemoryQualifiers
methods.description: Generates memory qualifiers like readonly, writeonly, coherent, restrict, volatile.

methods.name: writeLayoutQualifier
methods.description: Outputs layout qualifiers for variables, including location, binding, and other qualifiers.

methods.name: writeFieldLayoutQualifier
methods.description: Outputs layout qualifiers for struct fields, such as matrix packing.

methods.name: writeQualifier
methods.description: Outputs variable qualifiers and memory qualifiers.

methods.name: mapQualifierToString
methods.description: Maps internal qualifier enums to GLSL qualifier strings, considering shader version and options.

methods.name: writeVariableType
methods.description: Outputs variable type, including qualifiers, struct declarations, and precision.

methods.name: writeFunctionParameters
methods.description: Outputs function parameter list.

methods.name: writeConstantUnion
methods.description: Outputs constant union values, handling different types and structures.

methods.name: writeConstructorTriplet
methods.description: Outputs constructor syntax for types.

methods.name: visitSymbol
methods.description: Outputs symbol names, handling array syntax if declaring variables.

methods.name: visitConstantUnion
methods.description: Outputs constant union values.

methods.name: visitSwizzle
methods.description: Outputs swizzle operators.

methods.name: visitBinary
methods.description: Outputs binary operations, handling syntax for various operators.

methods.name: visitUnary
methods.description: Outputs unary operations, including built-in functions.

methods.name: visitTernary
methods.description: Outputs ternary conditional expressions.

methods.name: visitIfElse
methods.description: Outputs if-else statements.

methods.name: visitSwitch
methods.description: Outputs switch statements.

methods.name: visitCase
methods.description: Outputs case statements.

methods.name: visitBlock
methods.description: Outputs code blocks, handling scope and statement formatting.

methods.name: visitFunctionDefinition
methods.description: Outputs function definitions.

methods.name: visitGlobalQualifierDeclaration
methods.description: Outputs global qualifier declarations.

methods.name: visitFunctionPrototype
methods.description: Outputs function prototypes.

methods.name: visitAggregate
methods.description: Outputs aggregate nodes, such as function calls and constructors.

methods.name: visitDeclaration
methods.description: Outputs variable declarations with qualifiers and layout.

methods.name: visitLoop
methods.description: Outputs loop constructs (for, while, do-while).

methods.name: visitBranch
methods.description: Outputs branch statements like break, continue, return.

methods.name: visitCodeBlock
methods.description: Outputs code blocks with proper scope.

methods.name: visitPreprocessorDirective
methods.description: Outputs preprocessor directives.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the string name of a type.

methods.name: hashName
methods.description: Returns hashed name for symbols.

methods.name: hashFieldName
methods.description: Returns hashed name for struct fields.

methods.name: hashFunctionNameIfNeeded
methods.description: Returns function name, hashed if not main.

methods.name: structDeclared
methods.description: Checks if a struct has been declared.

methods.name: declareStruct
methods.description: Declares a struct in GLSL code.

methods.name: declareInterfaceBlockLayout
methods.description: Declares layout for interface blocks.

methods.name: declareInterfaceBlock
methods.description: Declares an interface block.
